channel.title: Syamjith NK
channel.description: Measured notes on Arabic text handling, and the upstream fixes that came out of them.

item.title: I scanned 341 Arabic datasets to see if the corruption reaches training data
item.description: 276 Arabic datasets readable, 119,517 text fields scanned, one fully corrupted OCR ground-truth set. And a false positive that nearly got published.

item.title: 3,168 files use the broken Arabic recipe. Most of them are fine.
item.description: Whether the reshape+bidi recipe is a bug depends on what draws the text. On a sample of six real projects, half were fine.

item.title: The auto-fix for corrupted Arabic produces a real word. The wrong one.
item.description: Undoing reshape+bidi corruption round-trips exactly, until the text contains a lam-alef ligature.

item.title: Your Pillow version does not tell you whether Arabic will work
item.description: Shaping support is decided when the wheel is built, not by the version number.

item.title: The Arabic fix everyone recommends is now the bug
item.description: The most-copied recipe for rendering Arabic in Python reverses your text on matplotlib 3.11.
